subject: Requesting SOC 2 Type II + bridge path to meet procurement signature window (Nebula Health)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nebulahealth.com>, procurement@nebulahealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting SOC 2 Type II + bridge path to meet procurement signature window (Nebula Health)

Hi Ellen / Nebula procurement team —

Thanks for the quick review on the contract. We’re targeting a signature date of 2026-05-21 to hit your onboarding window and align with our quarter close. I understand from your intake that you require a SOC 2 Type II covering the most recent audit period and supporting evidence.

Can you confirm the exact audit period you need covered? We have a Type II report from our audit firm that covers 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30. If that doesn’t match your expectation, we can provide:
- a bridge letter summarizing control continuity since the report period,
- a limited evidence bundle (KMS rotation, access logs, change control snapshots), and
- an engineer attestation for specific control families.

We may not be able to obtain a fresh auditor-signed Type II within ten days, but we can produce a formal bridge + evidence package and execute a signed attestation via DocuSign. Would procurement accept that as a path to close? If not, please indicate the minimum items that legal/procurement require before they’ll sign.

For transparency I’ve cc’d our security and legal leads. If you can send over the vendor risk form and a prioritized checklist, we’ll triage and aim to deliver a draft bridge within 48–72 hours.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: none in initial message
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nebulahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Jacob Meyer <jacob.meyer@nebulahealth.com>, procurement@nebulahealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting SOC 2 Type II + bridge path to meet procurement signature window (Nebula Health)

Aditya —

Thanks for the quick note. Procurement and legal require a Type II report that covers at least the last 12 months of operations; our stated requirement is an audit period that ends no earlier than 2025-11-30. Your 2024-10-01–2025-09-30 report will unfortunately not meet our policy as-is.

We will consider a bridge letter or interim attestation if it: (1) is signed by an officer, (2) lists which control areas remain unchanged, and (3) includes recent evidence (KMS configuration/rotation proof, admin access logs for the past 90 days, and a data-retention statement).

Attached is our Vendor Risk Form — please populate and return with the bridge/evidence. Note: our legal team will still require time to review the documentation before signature.

Ellen Park
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
Nebula Health
ellen.park@nebulahealth.com

Hi Vivek/Laura —

Forwarding Nebula’s note and the vendor risk form. They require an audit period ending no earlier than 2025-11-30 — our latest auditor-signed Type II ends 2025-09-30. Procurement needs a path to sign by 2026-05-21.

Options I see (please advise quickly):
- Provide bridge letter + evidence bundle (preferred if acceptable to Nebula)
- Ask audit firm for a paid interim attestation/roll-forward (time & cost unknown; sounds like ~7 business days per initial checks)
- Other legal-safe compensating attestation that procurement will accept

Can security and compliance confirm what we can assemble in the next 48–72 hours (logs, KMS rotation proof, change control snapshots, attestation-language)? I’ll coordinate with sales ops for packaging and send to Ellen.

Thanks —
Aditya
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Requesting SOC 2 Type II + bridge path to meet procurement signature window (Nebula Health)

Ellen / team —

Thanks for the clarity. Short answer: we cannot generate a new auditor-signed Type II within ten days. We can, however, produce a formal bridge letter and a limited evidence bundle that should satisfy procurement in many cases. High level options with constraints:

1) Provide our existing Type II (2024-10-01–2025-09-30) + signed officer attestation noting no material changes since the report date. This is lowest friction but may not meet Nebula policy.

2) Produce a bridge letter that:
   - Summarizes control owners and changes since last Type II,
   - Attests that control families relevant to Nebula’s requests (access control, change management, encryption, logging) remain in place, and
   - Includes recent evidence: KMS rotation proof, admin access logs (sample with redactions), change-control snapshots from our ticketing system, and a runbook excerpt.

3) Engage our audit firm for an interim attestation or roll-forward signed by the auditor — possible but typically takes 5–10 business days and may incur fees.

Proposed immediate plan (48–72h):
- Rishi: pull admin access logs for the last 90 days and a redacted sample.
- Infra/ops: produce KMS rotation proof and key metadata. (Rishi to coordinate.)
- Laura/legal: draft bridge letter language and sign-off on attestation phrasing.
- Sales: package vendor risk form + bridge draft + evidence and deliver to procurement.

I’m attaching a bridge-letter template we’ve used as a baseline. If Nebula confirms they’ll accept a bridge + evidence bundle, we’ll proceed on this path.

Vivek
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: bridge-letter-template.docx (stub)
